name: Normandy Tribunal
description: The Hermetic Tribunal covering Normandy, Brittany and much of France, whose politics are dominated by liege-vassal lines of covenants and a scarcity of vis.

name: Stonehenge Tribunal
description: Tribunal whose meetings Breton covenants such as Fudarus attended before the Schism War.

name: Iberian Tribunal
description: Tribunal whose over-competitive team in 1151 earned 13th place in the Tourney, giving rise to the Siege of Shame.

name: Provençal Tribunal
description: Tribunal bordering the Normandy Tribunal near Rocamadour.

name: House Diedne
description: Hermetic House destroyed in the Schism War whose domus magna Branugurix lay near Mount Dol; several Normandy covenants were Diedne.

name: House Flambeau
description: Hermetic House that withdrew from the Normandy Tribunal after conflict with House Tytalus; its magical tournaments inspired the Hermetic Tourney.

name: House Tremere
description: Hermetic House whose magi fought in the Schism War in Normandy, some trapped in Branugurix's regio.

name: House Tytalus
description: Hermetic House of conflict whose domus magna is Fudarus; currently split between rival Primi Buliste and Harpax.

name: House Guernicus
description: Hermetic House of Quaesitores which holds records of Branugurix and uncovered Tasgillia's corruption.

name: House Ex Miscellanea
description: Hermetic House founded by Pralix; the sole survivor of Rotomagus joined it.

name: House Merinita
description: Hermetic House to which Jacques Vert belonged.

name: House Mercere
description: Hermetic House of Redcaps; Alcuin's Auberge was a small Mercer House founded by Redcaps.

name: Fudarus
description: Domus magna of House Tytalus on the Isle of Ushant, founded 798, and one of the five great liege lines of the Normandy Tribunal.

name: Confluensis
description: Great liege covenant founded 810, one of the five great lines; later relocated to the Cotentin peninsula.

name: Florum
description: Great liege covenant founded 907 in Flanders, one of the five great lines.

name: Oleron
description: Great liege covenant founded 1028 in Aquitaine, one of the five great lines.

name: Montverte
description: Great liege covenant founded 941 in Normandy, one of the five great lines; its Flambeau and Tremere magi destroyed Bibracte.

name: Branugurix
description: Domus magna of House Diedne (791-1012) in a regio near Mount Dol, sealed by the Diedne Primus in the final battle of the Schism War.

name: Bibracte
description: Vassal of Fudarus (822-969) on Mount Beauvray that revived a cult of Vercingetorix and was destroyed by Wizard Wars from Montverte magi.

name: Pagus
description: Vassal of Confluensis (840-1008) at a Roman outpost near Cherbourg, damaged by Vikings and destroyed in the Schism War.

name: Baiocassium
description: Diedne vassal of Branugurix (851-1011) in the forest near Bayeux, on good terms with local faeries.

name: Sinapis
description: Important liege covenant in Anjou (855-1063), abandoned after the Flambeau-Tytalus conflict.

name: Rotomagus
description: Covenant near Rouen (875-892) founded by apprentices of Sinapis and destroyed when Vikings sacked Rouen.

name: Ligurio
description: Vassal of Fudarus (913-1011) in the Vendée, destroyed by giants presumed sent by Kerguntuil.

name: Kerguntuil
description: Diedne vassal of Branugurix (920-1007) on the Rose Coast, interested in giant lore.

name: Baiocassium Minor
description: Vassal of Baiocassium (936-1005) within Bayeux, destroyed in the Schism War.

name: Caput Capra
description: Easternmost Diedne covenant (981-1005) on the Loire near Fleury, first casualty of the Schism War in the Tribunal.

name: Aedes Salii
description: Vassal of Sinapis on Jersey (998-1063) founded to coordinate the Schism War, named after the Salii.

name: Orchard of Sour Apples
description: Vassal of Confluensis (1020-1051), later the site to which Confluensis relocated.

name: Lixivia
description: Vassal of Florum (1021-1124) in Champagne of Redcaps and Gentle Gifted magi acting as intermediary with merchants; disbanded in poverty.

name: Vexatores
description: Vassal of Fudarus (1048-1064) founded 21 miles from Sinapis to provoke it during the Flambeau-Tytalus conflict.

name: Dragon's Rest
description: Vassal of Confluensis founded 1051 on the site Confluensis originally occupied.

name: Lapis Crudus
description: Covenant founded 1063, considered part of the line of Sinapis, located in Ile de France.

name: Nauche-Fleur
description: Vassal of Montverte (1072-1166) running a martial and academic school near Niort.

name: Infelicitas
description: Vassal of Fudarus (1099-1158) founded when Rancrax lost a wager; foundered after his death.

name: Nidi
description: Vassal of Oleron founded 1100 in Aquitaine.

name: Spider's Palace
description: Vassal of Florum founded 1117 on Florum's original site.

name: Requies Aeterna
description: Vassal of Florum founded 1123 in Flanders & Picardy.

name: Alcuin's Auberge
description: Vassal of Florum (1124-1197), a small Mercer House in Tours founded by Redcaps from Lixivia.

name: Moles Magna
description: Vassal of Oleron (1136-1182) built within a dam on the edge of the Morvan, destroyed when the dam burst.

name: Atsingani
description: Vassal of Montverte founded 1187 in Anjou.

name: Cunfin
description: Vassal of Confluensis founded 1192 in Champagne & Burgundy.

name: Atramentum
description: Vassal of Fudarus (1200-1201) whose founders were evicted by the magi who formed Exspectatio.

name: Exspectatio
description: Vassal of Fudarus in the Arrée Mountains, occupied by six Tytalan magi who left Fudarus during the Primi feud.

name: Atramentum Renatus
description: Vassal of Exspectatio in Burgundy founded 1201 by the founders of Atramentum.

name: Eboris
description: Covenant founded 1204 in Ile de France.

name: Cabal of the Golden Coin
description: Secret cabal, begun by Tytalus magi, that fixes the outcome of Hermetic Tourney contests to maximize prizes.

name: Cabal of the Leaden Cart
description: Tytalan cabal Iasper seeks to join and in which Kybella is involved.

name: Titanoi
description: House Tytalus's cult of theurgists, of which Kybella is a leading member.

name: Quaesitores
description: Hermetic investigators who oversee Tribunal cases, fines and the Tourney.

name: Knights Templar
description: Military order that built a chapel at Lanleff and Brélévenez Church, reportedly at a Quaesitor's suggestion.

name: Heusaff family
description: Ancient Breton family owning the Isle of Ushant; Lord Heusaff is secretly a guise of the Primus.

name: Foutins
description: Large clan of local roustabouts, Iasper's mundane family.

name: Veniti
description: Strongest tribe of Gauls, defeated by Julius Caesar at sea off Morbihan.

name: Salii
description: Priests of Mars after whom Aedes Salii was named.

name: Five Great Lines
description: The five liege-vassal lines of Fudarus, Confluensis, Florum, Oleron and Montverte dominating Normandy politics.

name: Tytalus
description: Founder of House Tytalus who built Fudarus in 798 after stealing away Hariste.

name: Pralix
description: Filia of Tytalus and founder of House Ex Miscellanea, former home at Fudarus.

name: Tasgillia
description: Prima of House Tytalus corrupted by demons, captured by House Guernicus in 961.

name: Hariste
description: Apprentice of Pralix stolen by Tytalus; first Prima of House Tytalus who directed crafting of the Rod and Circlet.

name: Kalliste
description: Prima of House Tytalus who resisted Quaesitores searching Fudarus after Tasgillia's fall.

name: Klynoites
description: Primus of House Tytalus who wrested control of three Diedne-summoned spirits during the Schism War.

name: Buliste
description: Prima of House Tytalus, filia of Bulcis, who returned from Final Twilight and disputes leadership with Harpax; wears the Circlet of the Primus.

name: Harpax
description: Tenth Primus of House Tytalus, filius of Bulcis, holds the Rod of the Primus and poses as Lord Heusaff.

name: Bulcis
description: Master of both Buliste and Harpax.

name: Rancrax
description: Tytalus magus who founded Infelicitas after losing a wager, slain in Wizard's War by a magus of Moles Magna.

name: Notatus
description: Magus with an affinity for the number seven, after whom the Siege of Notatus is named.

name: Adanos
description: Tytalus magus of Exspectatio with earth-spirit blood, supporter of Harpax.

name: Kybella
description: Tytalus theurgist of Exspectatio, Titanoi member, who maintains Fudarus's spirit enchantments and casts its Aegis.

name: Iasper
description: Young Tytalus magus of Exspectatio, filius of Adanos, with an affinity for turmoil.

name: Jacques Vert
description: Merinita magus who speculated the Nains were dreams of dead Diedne and vanished at Carnac.

name: Trianoma
description: Founding figure of the Order whose meeting with Diedne is placed at Carnac.

name: Diedne
description: Founder of House Diedne, said to have met Trianoma at Carnac.

name: Vercingetorix
description: Gaulish hero whose cult Bibracte revived.

name: Louis I the Pious
description: Frankish king, son of Charlemagne, who established Brittany as a duchy.

name: Charlemagne
description: Father of Louis the Pious.

name: Nominoé
description: Ninth-century duke and king of Brittany who won independence and founded St. Magloire.

name: Charles II the Bald
description: Successor of Louis defeated by Nominoé.

name: Erispoë
description: Nominoé's son, who took the title King of Brittany.

name: Salomon
description: King of Brittany who took the throne by assassination; martyred in the ninth century.

name: Alain Barbe-Torte
description: Breton king (Crookbeard) who died in 952.

name: Alain IV Fergent
description: Duke of Brittany who ended a century of disorder.

name: Henry II of England
description: King who added Brittany to his holdings between 1158 and 1166.

name: King John of England
description: English king rumored to have murdered Arthur of Brittany.

name: Arthur of Brittany
description: Nephew of King John whose rumored murder led to Breton independence.

name: Peter I of Dreux
description: Current regent of the duchy of Brittany through marriage to Alice.

name: Alice of Brittany
description: Heiress of the former Breton ruling house, wife of Peter of Dreux.

name: Raoul II
description: Baron of Fougères who led Breton nobles against Henry II.

name: Geoffroy of Corseul
description: Man who extended St. Magloire in the new style.

name: Merlin
description: Wizard who fell for Viviane and is believed asleep under the Stone of Merlin.

name: Viviane
description: Faerie Lady of the Lake who enchanted Merlin and lives at Lake Comper; queen of the korrigan.

name: Sir Lancelot
description: Knight raised by Viviane who first kissed Guinevere at the Bridge of Secrets.

name: Queen Guinevere
description: Queen whose kiss with Lancelot occurred at the Bridge of Secrets.

name: Morgan Le Fay
description: Half-sister of King Arthur who imprisoned Guyomart in the Valley of No Return.

name: King Arthur
description: Legendary king; a cave in the Arrée Mountains is where he once slept.

name: Guyomart
description: Unfaithful lover of Morgan Le Fay trapped at False Lover's Rock.

name: King Gradlon
description: Sixth-century King of Cornouaille whose city Is drowned; founded Quimper.

name: Dahut
description: Gradlon's daughter, seduced by the Devil, who became the siren Marie-Morgane.

name: Marie-Morgane
description: Evil siren, formerly Dahut, who drowns sailors to people sunken Is.

name: Peter Abélard
description: Philosopher and theologian who retreated to St-Gildas-de-Rhuys.

name: Julius Caesar
description: Roman general who watched the defeat of the Veniti from Tumiac Tumulus.

name: Pomponius Mela
description: Roman historian who claimed nine virgin witches lived on Sein Island.

name: Duke Mark
description: Ruler who refused St. Paul a bell.

name: Princess of the Shining Star
description: Young lady confined in a glass tower in a Magic regio (story seed).

name: Mother of Winds
description: Bearded old woman with four giant sons she keeps in order with her sack.

name: Jean and Jeanne
description: Petrified betrothed couple, two menhirs on Belle-ile, who could be freed by ritual.

name: Ronan
description: Irish hermit who settled at St. Renan; St. Ronan's walk is retraced at Locronan.

name: St. Maclou
description: Welsh founder of Breton Christianity commemorated at St. Malo; converted Gauls at Aleth.

name: St. Broch
description: Welsh saint commemorated at St. Brieuc, with a fountain granting a Blessing.

name: St. Guirec
description: Welsh saint commemorated at Perros Guirec.

name: St. Paul the Aurelian
description: Founder of the bishopric of St-Pol-de-Léon who subdued a dragon on Batz.

name: St. Samson
description: Welsh saint commemorated at Dol, where a cathedral to him is built.

name: St. Tugdual
description: Welsh saint commemorated at Tréguier.

name: St. Corentine
description: First bishop of Quimper who lived off a regenerating magical fish.

name: St. Patern
description: Welsh saint commemorated at Vannes.

name: St. Michael
description: Archangel said to have fought the Devil at Mount Dol.

name: St. Nerius
description: Saint martyred beside the gates of Fudarus, site of a Divine aura.

name: St. Cornelius
description: Saint said to have turned pursuing faeries into the Carnac stones.

name: St. Arthmael
description: Founder of Ploëmel who defeated a dragon.

name: St. Cado
description: Saint with a chapel curing the deaf and a fertility pillar.

name: St. Gildas
description: Founder of St-Gildas-de-Rhuys monastery.

name: St. Guénolé
description: Founder of the abbey at Landévennec.

name: St. Columba
description: Saint whose followers founded Daoulas abbey.

name: St. Briac
description: Saint petitioned at Bourbriac for those subject to fits.

name: St. Matthew
description: Apostle whose lost head-relic at St. Matthew's Point quells storms.

name: Our Lady
description: The Virgin, venerated at many Breton shrines including Josselin and Our Lady of Haut.

name: Our Lady of Haut healing saints
description: Saints petitioned at Our Lady of Haut: St. Mamertus, St. Livertin, St. Eugenia, St. Leobinus, St. Méen, St. Hubert, St. Houarniaule.

name: Korrigan
description: Breton faeries: hunchbacked manikins with cat's claws and goat's hooves who dance and may take the form of a beautiful woman; dangerous in Brocéliande.

name: Nain
description: Infernal imp-like guardians of the Carnac stones, once korrigan, who lure victims with false treasure and deadly dances.

name: Black Dog
description: Dog in which the spirit of a deceased family member is trapped by a folk ritual; Divine Might 10.

name: Ankeu
description: Death personified in Brittany as a skeleton with a scythe driving a spectral cart.

name: Mogidell
description: Great Spirit of Ushant of mists and sea-fog, appearing as a huge gray bird.

name: Kerseenn
description: Great Spirit of Ushant of misdirection, constantly shifting shape.

name: Arnev
description: Great Spirit of Ushant of stormy weather, a serpent with a horse's head.

name: Three Great Spirits of Ushant
description: Three mighty spirits bound into Fudarus's walls as genii loci, protecting the covenant.

name: Genius Loci
description: Spirit of place; examples include Ushant's spirits and the feuding spirits of Corong and Toul Goulic gorges.

name: Siren
description: Sea spirit; one guards a natural bridge near St. Malo.

name: Giants
description: Beings of Breton legend associated with dolmens and the covenant Kerguntuil.

name: Devil
description: The Devil, fought by St. Michael at Mount Dol and seducer of Dahut.

name: White Fox
description: Magic creature that gives an ivory ball leading to a hermit.

name: Magical Fish of St. Corentine
description: Regenerating fish with Divine Might 2 that fed St. Corentine.

name: Crossroads Faerie
description: Faerie governing the transition between life and death that afflicts Iasper.

name: Faerie Court of Faeries' Rock
description: Faerie court that assembles at Faeries' Rock before the winter solstice to try transgressors.

name: Servant Spirits of Fudarus
description: Invisible spirits performing menial tasks at Fudarus, commanded by the Circlet of the Primus.

name: Dragon
description: Dragons subdued by St. Paul on Batz and St. Arthmael at Ploëmel.

name: Air Elemental
description: Elemental that harasses a covenant with wind in a story seed.

name: Rod of the Primus
description: Enchanted rod of Fudarus controlling rooms' environment; symbol of House Tytalus leadership, held by Harpax.

name: Circlet of the Primus
description: Enchanted circlet commanding Fudarus's servant spirits, worn by Buliste.

name: Casting Tablet
description: Device allowing a spell to be cast; the Tribunal provides one for The Shrouded Glen.

name: Relic of St. Matthew
description: Lost head of St. Matthew with the power to quell storms at sea.

name: Ivory Ball
description: Ball given by the White Fox that rolls toward a hermit.

name: Statue of Our Lady of Josselin
description: Wooden Virgin statue before which local women beg forgiveness to avert a curse.

name: Venus of Castennac
description: Pagan female statue used in rituals that always reappears when thrown in the river.

name: The Shrouded Glen
description: Spell used to conceal the Tourney site; a Moon-duration version is available as a casting tablet.

name: Sight of the Active Magics
description: Intellego Vim spell used by dimicatio referees.

name: Ball of Abysmal Flame
description: Spell that is a crowd pleaser in the dimicatio.

name: Aegis of the Hearth
description: Ritual protecting a covenant; Kybella casts it for Fudarus.

name: Panic of the Trembling Heart
description: CrMe spell, known by Iasper and imitated by the Black Dog's bark.

name: Weight of a Thousand Hells
description: Spell imitated by the Black Dog's Dreadful Howl.

name: Chaos of the Angry Waves
description: ReAq 30 spell known by Iasper.

name: Confusion of the Insane Vibrations
description: ReIm 30 spell known by Iasper.

name: Confusion of the Numbed Will
description: ReMe 15 spell known by Iasper.

name: Crest of the Earth's Wave
description: ReTe 20 spell known by Iasper.

name: Prying Eyes
description: InIm 5 spell known by Iasper.

name: The Earth's Carbuncle
description: ReTe(Mu) 15 spell known by Iasper.

name: Wielding the Invisible Sling
description: ReTe 10 spell known by Iasper.

name: Sense the Nature of Vis
description: Spell revealing the Nains' fake vis.

name: Control Environment of Fudarus
description: Six enchantments of the Rod of the Primus varying light, heat, portals, smells, noises and textures.

name: Control Spirit
description: Rego Vim 55 power of the Circlet of the Primus commanding spirits.

name: Human Form
description: Korrigan power to assume a beautiful woman's form.

name: Fearsome Bark
description: Black Dog power like Panic of the Trembling Heart.

name: Dreadful Howl
description: Black Dog power like Weight of a Thousand Hells.

name: Glittering Treasure
description: Nain power creating vanishing silver coins.

name: Deadly Dance
description: Nain power compelling victims to dance until sunrise.

name: Magician's Desire Denied
description: Nain power making objects appear as vis.

name: Mastery of Mist
description: Mogidell's power over mist and fog.

name: Mastery of Misdirection
description: Kerseenn's power over misdirection.

name: Mastery of Storms
description: Arnev's power over bad weather.

name: Incorporeal
description: Power making the Ushant spirits invisible and intangible.

name: Presence
description: Power making the Ushant spirits aware of all on Ushant.

name: The Gift
description: Virtue listed in this text (e.g. for Iasper or the Black Dog).

name: Hermetic Magus
description: Virtue listed in this text (e.g. for Iasper or the Black Dog).

description: Flaw listed in this text.

name: Lesser Malediction
description: Fudarus grogs suffer a Lesser Malediction making them blind to certain colors.

name: Powerful Ally
description: Covenant Boon a vassal may gain from a favorable oath.

name: Beholden
description: Covenant Hook common for vassals.

name: Indebted
description: Covenant Hook for vassals.

name: Favors
description: Covenant Hook for vassals.

name: Favors Owed
description: Covenant Boon for lieges.

name: Hidden Resources
description: Covenant Boon representing vassal tithes to liege.

name: Promised Favors
description: Minor covenant Boon for lieges.

name: Protector
description: Minor covenant Hook for lieges.

name: Breton
description: Language of western Brittany, rarely written.

name: Parma Magica
description: Hermetic magic resistance; may not be extended over hastiludium mounts and must not be penetrated in the dimicatio.

name: Creo

name: Magic Realm
description: Realm of Magic; Magic auras found at Carnac, Fudarus, Bréhat and elsewhere.

name: Faerie Realm
description: Realm of Faerie; Faerie auras in Brocéliande and Gavrinis.

name: Divine Realm
description: Realm of the Divine; Divine auras at St Nerius's site and Dominion at Our Lady of Haut.

name: Infernal Realm
description: Realm of the Infernal; Carnac has an Infernal aura at night.

name: Oath of Fealty
description: Legally enforceable oath binding a vassal covenant to its liege under Normandy's Peripheral Code.

name: Liege and Vassal Covenants
description: Feudal system by which established covenants sponsor and control new vassal covenants in Normandy.

name: Peripheral Code
description: Tribunal-specific Hermetic law, including fealty oaths and seisin rules.

name: Code of Hermes
description: Founding law of the Order.

name: Vis
description: Raw magical power harvested from sources; scarce in the Normandy Tribunal.

name: Seisin
description: A vis source legally owned by a covenant.

name: Legacy
description: Lease of a vis source granted by the Tribunal.

name: Tropaeum
description: Vis source lease distributed as a Tourney prize for seven years.

name: Hermetic Tourney
description: Contest held after each Normandy Tribunal meeting to distribute tropaea and prizes.

name: Hastiludium
description: Tourney event of mounted melee on ordinary objects using magic.

name: Certamen
description: Hermetic magical duel; the certamen tournament is a Tourney event.

name: Joust
description: Tourney's most dangerous event, a knightly joust between mounted magi.

name: Melee
description: Tourney event in which grogs try to capture opponents' magical castles.

name: Dimicatio
description: Flambeau favorite Tourney event of forceless spells blocked by fast-cast defense.

name: Hosting Covenant's Choice
description: Tourney event chosen by the hosting covenant.

name: Siege of Normandy
description: First place in the Tourney.

name: Siege of Valor
description: Second place in the Tourney.

name: Siege of Notatus
description: Seventh place in the Tourney, granted a greater prize.

name: Siege of Shame
description: Thirteenth place, which receives no prize.

name: Siege of Alms
description: 21st place, a consolation prize.

name: Prize Pawns
